extDesc.message: Fill orOS passwords, cards and addresses into pages, save pages to orOS, ask its Assistant, search orOS.

optBaseHint.message: Leave it as https://useoros.online/ unless you run your own copy of orOS.

optBad.message: Use an https:// address (http:// only for localhost).

optHow1.message: Alt+Shift+O: save the page you are on. The toolbar button opens a small window with Save this page to orOS and your passwords.

optHow2.message: Right-click a page or a link: Save to orOS.

optHow3.message: Type oros, a space and some words in the address bar to search orOS.

optHow4.message: orOS opens in a new tab with the bookmark ready. Nothing is saved until you press Save there.

optHow5.message: Select text, right-click it: Ask the orOS Assistant. orOS opens its Assistant with the text in the message box; nothing is sent until you press Send.

optPrivacy.message: This add-on collects nothing and talks to no server. Saving opens orOS with the page's address and title, or with the text you selected for the Assistant (in the part of the address that never leaves your browser). For passwords it keeps an encrypted copy of your vault, read from your orOS tab; your master password is never stored, and the opened vault key is kept in memory only until the lock time or until the browser closes.

popTitle.message: orOS: save this page, fill a password

cmdPopup.message: Open orOS (save the page, fill a password)

pmNeedPerm.message: To fill passwords, the add-on reads your encrypted vault from orOS at $1. Allow it once.

pmNoCopy.message: Open orOS ($1) and its Passwords app once in this browser. The add-on then keeps an encrypted copy of your vault and opens it with your master password.

pmFuture.message: This vault comes from a newer orOS. Update the add-on.

pmErr.message: The vault could not be opened.

pmAt.message: Copy of your vault from orOS: $1

pmMoved.message: The page changed. Open the add-on again.

pmNoAccess.message: The add-on cannot reach this page.

pmNoFields.message: No fields to fill were found on this page.

optForget.message: Remove the vault copy from this browser

optHow6.message: Ctrl+Shift+L or the toolbar button: fill a login (with its 2FA code), a card or an address into the page. Nothing is filled without your click, and a login fills only on its own site.

pmFrameAsk.message: The card number is in a payment frame from $1. Fill the card there too?

pmSaveLogin.message: Save the login from this page

pmSaveAsk.message: Send the login for $1 ($2) to Passwords in orOS? You check it there and press Save.

pmSaveNone.message: No password typed on this page yet. Type it in the form first, then try again.

pmSaveFail.message: orOS could not be reached. Open orOS and try again.
